label: 0031 · Smoothed in time, 1997–2025 (one QP over all windows of 0024): 0030 with background coupling free to change where the data demand it, correlated noise, fixed 747-site network, UNR positions (MAP)
description: 0030 with an adaptive prior on changes in background coupling. A change between windows larger than half its prior SD over a patch about 100 km across costs only logarithmically more (iteratively reweighted), so a change the data demand is no longer shrunk away. Windows shorter than 180 days, and patches where an afterslip state's prior is larger than the background's, keep 0030's Gaussian prior; without these rules the early postseismic signal and part of the Tohoku afterslip went into the background. The background changes in 11 patch-windows: the Bungo Channel in 2009–11 and 2018–21, during the 2010 and 2018–19 slow slip events (regional mean 0.20 in 2009–11, against 0.24 in 0030); central Shikoku in 2022–23; and the deep southern Japan Trench in 2007–09 (0.11, against 0.19), where the 2008 Ibaraki-oki (Mw 6.8) and Fukushima-oki (Mw 6.9) earthquakes, not modeled as events, may contribute afterslip. Elsewhere it matches 0030, and the fit is unchanged. The 2000–05 Tokai slow slip event is still not resolved. MAP solution, no posterior SD.
